description: Second-price replay of every auction win in league 1 from 2021 through 2025. This is the PRICING corpus: it is evidence that second-price resolution reproduces live-auction prices, and it says nothing about completeness or settlement mechanics. Each team's implied maximum is the highest amount it bid on that player, which is a lower bound on the winner's true ceiling and an exact reading of every runner-up's, since a runner-up was outbid at theirs.
source: league_production, league 1, transactions type 6 (AUCTION_BID) and type 7 (AUCTION_PROCESSED)
expectation_derivation: expected_winner_tid and expected_price are computed by the SQL below, independently of libs-server/resolve-auction-player.mjs. The spec asserts the resolver reproduces them, so a divergence is an engine bug rather than a new finding.
claims_sql:
with bids as (
  select pid, season_year, tid, player_salary as amount, occurred_at, transaction_id
  from transactions
  where lid = 1 and type = 6 and season_year between 2021 and 2025
),
opening as (
  select distinct on (season_year, pid)
    season_year, pid, tid as nominating_team_id, amount as opening_bid
  from bids
  order by season_year, pid, occurred_at, transaction_id
),
team_max as (
  select distinct on (season_year, pid, tid)
    season_year, pid, tid, amount as maximum_bid, occurred_at as amount_set_at
  from bids
  order by season_year, pid, tid, amount desc, occurred_at, transaction_id
),
wins as (
  select distinct on (season_year, pid)
    season_year, pid, tid as actual_winner_tid, player_salary as actual_price
  from transactions
  where lid = 1 and type = 7 and season_year between 2021 and 2025
  order by season_year, pid, occurred_at, transaction_id
)
select json_agg(rec order by season_year, pid) as players from (
  select w.season_year, w.pid,
    json_build_object(
      'season_year', w.season_year,
      'pid', w.pid,
      'nominating_team_id', o.nominating_team_id,
      'opening_bid', o.opening_bid,
      'claims', json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'tid', tm.tid,
          'maximum_bid', tm.maximum_bid,
          'amount_set_at', to_char(tm.amount_set_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
        ) order by tm.maximum_bid desc, tm.amount_set_at, tm.tid
      ),
      'actual_winner_tid', w.actual_winner_tid,
      'actual_price', w.actual_price
    ) as rec
  from wins w
  join opening o on o.season_year = w.season_year and o.pid = w.pid
  join team_max tm on tm.season_year = w.season_year and tm.pid = w.pid
  group by w.season_year, w.pid, w.actual_winner_tid, w.actual_price,
    o.nominating_team_id, o.opening_bid
) grouped
expectations_sql:
with bids as (
  select pid, season_year, tid, player_salary as amount, occurred_at, transaction_id
  from transactions where lid = 1 and type = 6 and season_year between 2021 and 2025
),
opening as (
  select distinct on (season_year, pid) season_year, pid, tid as nominating_team_id, amount as opening_bid
  from bids order by season_year, pid, occurred_at, transaction_id
),
team_max as (
  select distinct on (season_year, pid, tid) season_year, pid, tid, amount as maximum_bid, occurred_at as amount_set_at
  from bids order by season_year, pid, tid, amount desc, occurred_at, transaction_id
),
ranked as (
  select tm.*, o.nominating_team_id, o.opening_bid,
    row_number() over (partition by tm.season_year, tm.pid order by tm.maximum_bid desc,
      (case when tm.tid = o.nominating_team_id then 0 else 1 end), tm.amount_set_at, tm.tid) as rnk
  from team_max tm join opening o on o.season_year = tm.season_year and o.pid = tm.pid
)
select json_agg(json_build_object(
  'season_year', r1.season_year, 'pid', r1.pid,
  'expected_winner_tid', r1.tid,
  'expected_price', least(r1.maximum_bid, greatest(coalesce(r2.maximum_bid + 1, r1.opening_bid), r1.opening_bid))
) order by r1.season_year, r1.pid) as expected
from ranked r1
left join ranked r2 on r2.season_year = r1.season_year and r2.pid = r1.pid and r2.rnk = 2
where r1.rnk = 1
